item.title: Protesters, ICE face off with tensions high in Minneapolis after fatal shooting
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS — Protesters in Minneapolis shouted during a tense standoff with masked federal agents Thursday as public anger over the fatal shooting of a woman by an Immigration and Customs Enforcement officer continued to seethe.

item.title: Fisheries Department grants authorization for port expansion in Contrecoeur, Que.
item.description: MONTRÉAL — Fisheries and Oceans Canada has granted authorization to the Montreal Port Authority to expand a container port terminal northeast of the city in the habitat of an endangered fish species.

item.title: Conservative MP accuses students of free speech attack after campus event cancelled
item.description: OTTAWA — Conservative MP Garnett Genuis accused a student group at York University of attacking free speech after he was denied permission to hold an event there — but the university's student centre said politics had nothing to do with its decision.

item.title: Federal immigration officers shoot and wound 2 people in Portland, Oregon, authorities say
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (AP) — Federal immigration officers shot and wounded two people in a vehicle outside a hospital in Portland, Oregon, on Thursday, a day after an officer shot and killed a driver in Minnesota, authorities said.

item.title: Mound of garbage collapses at Philippine landfill, burying and trapping 38 people and killing 1
item.description: MANILA, Philippines (AP) — An avalanche of garbage and debris buried or trapped workers in low-slung buildings at a landfill in the Philippines, killing one person, injuring a dozen and leaving 38 others missing, officials said Friday.
